properties.text: Token comparison must use constant-time algorithm to prevent timing side-channel extraction.
properties.assertion: forall req: auth_compare(req.token, valid_token) uses timing_safe_equal, not ===

properties.text: assignRole must validate discord_role_id against an allowlist of managed roles.
properties.assertion: forall req: assignRole(uid, role_id) => role_id in managed_roles_allowlist

properties.text: removeRole must validate discord_role_id against an allowlist of managed roles.
properties.assertion: forall req: removeRole(uid, role_id) => role_id in managed_roles_allowlist

properties.text: CORS origin must not default to wildcard '*' when credentials are enabled.
properties.assertion: cors.credentials == true => cors.origin != '*'

properties.text: Supabase client must not fall back from service_role key to anon key silently.
properties.assertion: supabase_key == SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; fallback_to_anon_key => abort

properties.text: updateNickname must enforce ownership: caller can only update their own nickname.
properties.assertion: forall req: updateNickname(uid, name) => uid == caller.identity or caller.is_admin

properties.text: Nickname input must be sanitized and length-bounded before passing to Discord API.
properties.assertion: forall req: updateNickname(uid, name) => len(name) <= 32 && sanitized(name)

properties.text: Error handler must not leak internal error details regardless of NODE_ENV value.
properties.assertion: forall err: error_response.details == undefined || NODE_ENV == 'development'

properties.text: Health endpoint must not expose internal Discord connection state to unauthenticated callers.
properties.assertion: forall req: /health response excludes ws.status, guild.error internal details

properties.text: syncAllRoles must rate-limit Discord API calls to prevent rate limit exhaustion.
properties.assertion: forall sync: discord_api_calls_per_second(syncAllRoles) <= RATE_LIMIT_THRESHOLD

properties.text: getAllMembers must not allow unbounded bulk enumeration of all member data.
properties.assertion: forall req: getAllMembers response.data.length <= PAGINATION_LIMIT

properties.text: API_AUTH_TOKEN env var must be set for auth middleware to function; undefined must reject all.
properties.assertion: pre: process.env.API_AUTH_TOKEN != undefined => auth_functional; undefined => 500

properties.text: Every protected endpoint must pass through authMiddleware before handler execution.
properties.assertion: forall route in protected_routes: middleware_chain(route).includes(authMiddleware)

properties.text: syncRoles must validate discord_uid is non-empty string before querying Discord API.
properties.assertion: pre: syncRoles(uid) => typeof uid == 'string' && uid.length > 0

properties.text: createGeneration must validate generation is a positive integer within expected range.
properties.assertion: pre: createGeneration(gen) => typeof gen == 'number' && gen > 0 && gen < MAX_GEN

properties.text: After syncRoles, member must have exactly one generation role assigned.
properties.assertion: post: syncRoles(uid) => count(member.roles intersect generation_roles) == 1

properties.text: After syncRoles, status roles must be mutually exclusive (exactly one of JH/H/OB).
properties.assertion: post: syncRoles(uid) => count(member.roles intersect {JH,H,OB}) == 1

properties.text: After syncRoles, leader role present iff member exists in team_leaders table.
properties.assertion: post: syncRoles(uid) => member.has_role(leader) iff uid in team_leaders

properties.text: After syncRoles, member role granted only for status 0 (JH) or 1 (H), removed for 2 (OB).
properties.assertion: post: syncRoles(uid) => member.has_role(member_role) iff status in {0, 1}

properties.text: createGeneration must rollback Discord role if DB insert fails (atomicity).
properties.assertion: post: createGeneration(gen) fails_db => discord_role(gen) is deleted

properties.text: Discord bot token grants only necessary permissions; not admin-level access.
properties.assertion: assumption: discord_bot.permissions subset_of {MANAGE_ROLES, MANAGE_NICKNAMES, VIEW}

properties.text: Supabase RLS is not relied upon because service_role key bypasses it entirely.
properties.assertion: assumption: supabase_key == service_role => RLS bypassed; app must enforce access control

properties.text: All API callers are equally trusted; no per-user authorization or RBAC exists.
properties.assertion: assumption: forall caller: auth(caller) => caller.privileges == FULL_ACCESS

properties.text: discord_uid from request must be validated as numeric snowflake before use.
properties.assertion: forall req: discord_uid matches /^\d{17,20}$/ before passing to Discord API

properties.text: NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefixed env vars must not contain secrets (may be exposed in client bundles).
properties.assertion: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY != SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY

properties.text: getMember errors must distinguish not-found from API failure; not silently return null for both.
properties.assertion: forall uid: getMember(uid) error => error_type in {NOT_FOUND, API_ERROR}, not null

properties.text: getAllMembers must bound concurrent Discord API calls via Promise.all to prevent burst.
properties.assertion: forall sync: concurrent_discord_fetches(getAllMembers) <= MAX_CONCURRENT

properties.text: syncAllRoles failure for one member must not corrupt role state of other members.
properties.assertion: forall m1, m2: syncAllRoles failure(m1) => roles(m2) unchanged

properties.text: Soft-deleted members (deleted_at != null) must be excluded from all query results.
properties.assertion: forall query: results exclude members where deleted_at IS NOT NULL

properties.text: Generation uniqueness must be enforced atomically (DB unique constraint, not app-level check).
properties.assertion: forall gen: insert(generation_roles, gen) enforced by DB UNIQUE constraint

properties.text: syncRoles discord_uid from request body must not be trusted without cross-checking auth context.
properties.assertion: forall req: syncRoles(req.body.discord_uid) => uid validated against auth context

properties.text: ALLOWED_ORIGINS must be set in production; wildcard CORS must not be active.
properties.assertion: NODE_ENV == 'production' => ALLOWED_ORIGINS is defined && ALLOWED_ORIGINS != '*'

properties.text: assignRole/removeRole must check role hierarchy: bot cannot manage roles above its own position.
properties.assertion: pre: assignRole(uid, role_id) => role.position < bot_role.position

properties.text: Verified role must be granted to all DB-registered active members during syncRoles.
properties.assertion: post: syncRoles(uid) => member.has_role(verified) iff uid in members_table

properties.text: NODE_ENV must default to production-safe behavior when undefined (no error detail leakage).
properties.assertion: NODE_ENV == undefined => error_response behaves as NODE_ENV == 'production'
